title: Open-Cage Block Dumbbell
description: One original complete static block-shaped dumbbell: two thick chamfer-corner rectangular end weights are connected by four separate corner weight rails and one independent short gently swollen central grip. Ten complete opposed axial end-face contacts connect all seven closed editable parts. The grip sits inside a genuinely open rectangular cage, with a continuous finite clearance chamber around its full changing profile and four broad top, bottom, front and rear entry mouths. Both whole lower end-block soles rest at the ground datum. Three opaque constant untextured PBR materials; metres, native Z up, grip axis X, front -Y and ground-centred origin. One prop, zero scenes. All numeric geometry is newly authored. This is not a shortened circular-plate barbell, extra copies of existing weights, resized hex heads or a kettlebell conversion. No adjustable nested stack, selector pin, collar mechanism, removable plate, animation, texture, text or person is included. Fixed visual form only: no mass, exercise benefit, human fit, grip friction, lifting, movement, disassembly path, load, strength, stability, manufacture, installation, compatibility or fitness-equipment safety claim.
